Hull’s, X:10

I’ve tried to be the closest to the first playing of the tune by Fergal Scahill (day 1330) . Hope I’ve done good ;) Please listen to get a proper bowing https://www.facebook.com/FergalScahillMusic/videos/7906618442767980 It is said previously that the tune has been composed in Emaj, but you may notice that the tune is written without any D# , so it looks like a kind of “pentatonic” scale. (any specific mode?)
